name: serpin family E member 1

function.text: SERPINE1 encodes plasminogen activator inhibitor 1. Annotated molecular activities include endopeptidase inhibitor activity and serine-type endopeptidase inhibitor activity. It participates in angiogenesis and dentinogenesis.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to congenital plasminogen activator inhibitor type 1 deficiency (autosomal recessive).

function.text: SERPINE1 encodes plasminogen activator inhibitor 1. Based in part on similarity, it is a primary inhibitor of tissue-type plasminogen activator (PLAT) and urokinase-type plasminogen activator (PLAU). It functions as a regulator of cell migration, independently of its role as protease inhibitor. It is required for stimulation of keratinocyte migration during cutaneous injury repair.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with congenital plasminogen activator inhibitor type 1 deficiency (autosomal recessive).
